bash.name: bash
bash.description: Execute a bash command through this Member's confined terminal face and return its stdout/stderr. Each call runs in a fresh confined shell; pass `workdir` instead of using `cd`. Every path the command names is admitted against the compiled read lane before the shell starts; a refused read returns no bytes and names the typed refusal code in its error.

command.description: The bash command line to run (`bash -c`).

description.description: One short sentence describing what the command does.

workdir.description: Optional working directory; absolute, or relative to the session cwd.

teamCreateMember.name: team_create_member
teamCreateMember.description: Create a NEW member instance from a blueprint template (explicit creation; the activation authority enforces quota, envelope, and gates).

rootSessionId.description: The TeamSession (root session) id this operation belongs to.

requestToken.description: A token unique to THIS logical operation (non-empty, max 128 chars). Reuse the exact same token only when retrying the same logical operation; never reuse it for a different one.

delegationTemplateId.description: The blueprint template id the new member is created from.

label.description: A short human-readable label for the new member instance (non-empty).

groupId.description: Optional group id for the new member.

workspace.description: Optional workspace path override for the new member.
